fuselagePlugs.basis: Boeing D6-58326-1 and D6-58326-3. A 4.10 m forward barrel and 1.50 m aft barrel are removed from the short-deck 747-8F source. The 747-400 wing, winglets, pylons and four CF6 nacelles retain their original donor assembly.

componentTransplants.basis: Both FlightGear sources share the fuselage cross-section and center-section datum. Native 747-400 wing parts and hinges replace the 747-8F wing and GEnx nacelles.

fidelityNotes: Short upper-deck freighter with 747-400 winglets and CF6 nacelles. Cargo door surfaces are closed.
AirZeta current paint, using HL7616 as the reference airframe. The captured flight board does not identify a registration.

authoredPaint.method: Original airline paint layout projected in physical exterior coordinates; independent destination texture atlases retained.
